name: Images and Media Rulebook
summary: Photography, illustration, video and icons: what to use, how to prepare it, what never to ship.
check: Lighthouse image audits: modern formats, proper sizing, no lazy LCP image.
Check every image licence and alt text.

rules.title: Real photography
rules.text: Photos of the real product, place, team and work. Commission or take them; stock only for neutral textures and never for people presented as staff or customers.

rules.title: Consistent art direction
rules.text: All images share light, colour grade, crop logic and angle, so the site looks like one story.

rules.title: Modern formats and responsive sizes
rules.text: AVIF or WebP with a fallback, `srcset` and `sizes` for every content image, served at the size displayed (`PF-01`).

rules.title: Set the focal point
rules.text: Use `object-fit: cover` with `object-position` so faces and products stay in frame on every crop.

rules.title: Width, height and aspect ratio
rules.text: Every image and video has dimensions or `aspect-ratio` to prevent layout shift.

rules.title: Meaningful alt text
rules.text: Alt text says what the image shows and why it is there; decorative images use `alt=""` (`AX-07`).

rules.title: Video done properly
rules.text: Videos have a poster image, captions, controls, and are compressed for the web (H.264 or AV1, short loops under a few MB).

rules.title: SVG for icons and logos
rules.text: Icons and logos are optimised inline SVG or an SVG sprite, not icon fonts or PNGs.

rules.title: Credit and licence
rules.text: Every image that is not the client's own has a licence that allows the use, recorded in the project.

rules.title: Stock clichés
rules.text: No handshakes, people pointing at laptops, smiling call-centre headsets or generic city skylines.

rules.title: AI-generated people presented as real
rules.text: No generated faces or scenes passed off as real customers, staff, places or products.

rules.title: Text baked into images
rules.text: No headlines, prices or buttons inside images. Text stays HTML so it scales, translates and is read by screen readers and search engines.

rules.title: Upscaled or blurry images
rules.text: No images shown larger than their source resolution, and no visible compression artefacts.

rules.title: Autoplay with sound
rules.text: Video and audio never start with sound. Background video is muted, short, pausable and stops for reduced motion.

rules.title: Lazy-loading the first image
rules.text: Never lazy-load images in the first viewport, especially the largest one (`PF-22`).

rules.title: Blend white product shots into the page
rules.text: Product photos shot on white sit on a tinted card with `mix-blend-mode: multiply`, so the white square disappears and the product stands on the page's own colour. Do not use it on photos with white parts that must stay white (labels, white garments) or on dark backgrounds.
